title: Documentary Grain
line: 16 mm warmth: cream type on dark umber, amber accent, film grain, dust and warm light leaks.
line_zh: 16 毫米胶片的温度：深棕底上的米色字，琥珀点缀，胶片颗粒、灰尘与暖色漏光。
prompt: Documentary grain style: cream type on dark umber, one amber accent, 16 mm grain, light dust and warm light leaks, typewriter and mask-rise type, dissolves and dips, a calm ambient pad with a projector hum and typewriter keys.
prompt_zh: 纪录片颗粒风格：深棕底上的米色文字，一抹琥珀色，16 毫米胶片颗粒、轻微灰尘与暖色漏光，打字机与遮罩上升字效，叠化与淡入淡出，平静的氛围垫音，配放映机嗡声与打字机按键声。
essence: It feels found and true: warm film texture, quiet type that types itself out and slow dissolves. The texture is a frame around the words, not noise over them.

not.difference: Editorial Print is a light printed page; Documentary Grain is a dark projected frame.
Retro CRT is a green screen with scanlines; Documentary Grain is warm film with grain and dust.

palette.logic: a dark umber frame, cream ink, ONE amber for the key word; everything warm

camera.expresses: a slow look across a found image

sound.foley: a projector hum, typewriter keys and a soft hit

signature_features.text: cream ink on dark umber at 14:1, amber at 8:1 (contrast.py)
a mono typewriter face for every headline
dissolves, film burns and dips only
an ambient bed with projector and typewriter sounds
grain, dust and leaks visible but never over the words; no black gate or bars

demo.lint: mp lint 99.0/100, 54 PASS, 2 WARN, 0 FAIL, 0 INFO, 13 N/A
demo.made_by: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) through mp plan --style, mp new, mp render (HyperFrames, CRF 18) and mp lint; 0 human rounds; the same placeholder copy in every style

honesty: The demo is one run on a neutral placeholder subject (a fictional late-night library, labelled placeholder). The same prompt makes a different film on every run.
